conclusions.label: inferred
conclusions.text: Scalar playfield-boundary reserve is not equivalent to hazard-space global viability; an uncontrollable prefix or boundary clamp erases terminal recovery direction and distant-safe-region topology.

conclusions.label: inferred
conclusions.text: The contact bullet first entered the retained nearby set while an older hazard-version policy continued to certify down-left; the next hazard-version policy declared the kernel empty. The compact trace does not prove whether slot 455 was already present outside the retained nearby set in snapshot 801, so attribution to this specific birth remains unresolved. Ordinary exact action authority still needs complete versioned future-hazard coverage or a hard set-valued pre-publication predecessor, not another scalar boundary threshold.

conclusions.label: decision
conclusions.text: Do not rerun after merely deleting the bad predeath check, do not run the conditional Stage-5 follow-up, and do not tune local ranking. Redesign the ordinary global/pre-exhaustion authority first.
